name: fabriscope
description: 부품 제조의 생산·자재·품질·LOT 계보를 연결하는 MES

scripts.db:seed: corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/api prisma:generate && corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/api db:seed
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/api typecheck
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/web test && corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/api test
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/web build && corepack pnpm --filter @fabriscope/api build
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm docs:check
